name: Hakimasu
source:
People go about differently when falling in unrequited love.

Masu surmises it to be the traditional way: a clump of flowers by the doorstep, alongside a handwritten poem, but Haki doesn't seem to appreciate it. What's so wrong about courting your soulmate with the flowers you puked out, and a message signed with your own blood?

[From [url=https://hankworx.itch.io/hakimasu]Itch.io[/url]]
